[LADP.7.1] Two parallel mechanisms by which facts enter working memory
not-as-live-events. One carries a slot convention rules can match on;
the other does not, and that is a property of the mechanism rather
than a missing feature ([LADP.7.3.1]). Fact hydration, a third, is deferred
([LHYD.1]).

| Mechanism | Slot convention | Source |
|---|---|---|
| MQTT retained | `retained = true` | broker's "last payload" replay on new subscriber |
| Discovery burst | none | a discovery-driven adapter's one-per-entity burst at connect — indistinguishable from live ([LADP.7.3.1]) |
